name: Certn
description: Monitor Certn background check platform for employee verification and access management compliance

config.setupInstructions:
1. Log in to Certn at https://app.certn.co/login
2. Confirm your account is on CertnCentric (the current platform). If you are still on Certn Legacy, contact Certn support to migrate — the legacy API is being shut off on 2026-08-05.
3. Go to Settings > API Keys
4. Create a new API key and copy the value (it is only shown once)
5. Paste the key here
